environment.description: IoT gateway device (ARM Cortex-A53) running custom Linux 4.19 with BusyBox, deployed in a flat network segment with direct internet connectivity via cellular modem (Quectel EC25). Device has MQTT broker connection to cloud endpoint on port 8883. No ASLR (disabled for deterministic real-time behavior), heap allocator is dlmalloc without hardening. Device accepts raw MQTT frames on local TCP port 1883 from any source on the network.

config.network: flat L2 segment with NAT to internet via cellular
